decisions.reason: As a design-led decorative line launched in 2019, this devoré fabric is relatively trend-sensitive and, after a few seasons, management would likely replace it with fresher collection items.
Transparent burnout decorative fabrics are fashion-driven and less likely to justify long-term stocking continuity, so the firm would be inclined to phase them out for newer designs.
This burnout decorative fabric sits close to the existing range but is still a style product, making discontinuation fairly likely once its collection cycle matures.
A velour-like upholstery fabric fits the firm’s core upholstery offer and is more likely to remain in range if it supports dependable repeat orders and warehouse availability.

A flame-retardant plain inbetween fabric is a functional, specification-led product that suits professional buyers and is likely to stay because it strengthens the firm’s service-oriented core business.
A polyester lining fabric with satin sheen is a practical complement to the established assortment and is likely to be retained as a steady stock item rather than a short-lived fashion line.
